name: Shitoukazer
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:vehicle)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "National Defense Machine God", Shitoukazer is a massive pilotable mech Teigu entered via its chest core, with insane durability, physical strength, mortar barrages, homing missiles, and giant laser cannons. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it. (A/N: No Purge Mode).
